description: A multi-interaction navigation test that drives Compose semantics inline — raw composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag(...).performClick()/waitForIdle() chains, hardcoded tag string literals ('nav_item_search', 'festival_list'), and a bare assert(...) — instead of going through a test robot with domain-language helpers. The android-ui-testing skill makes the robot pattern mandatory for tests exercising more than one screen interaction. The reviewer must FAIL it; the headline is the missing robot.
